SSRF vulnerability: URL validation only checks if URL starts with 'https://insecurewebapp.com'. This can be bypassed using URLs like 'https://insecurewebapp.com.evil.com' or 'https://insecurewebapp.com@evil.com'. User-controlled URL is passed to urllib.request.urlopen().

Path traversal vulnerability: Weak regex pattern r'/\.\./\.\./' only catches '../../' exactly. Does not prevent traversal via '..', '../..', '....//', URL-encoded variants, or other bypass techniques. User input from self.path is directly concatenated to file path and opened without proper sanitization.
